title: erodium cicutarium
intro: Erodium cicutarium, commonly known as redstem filaree or stork's bill, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the geranium family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating wounds, and alleviating symptoms of digestive issues such as diarrhea and ulcers. The therapeutic actions of Erodium cicutarium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's bioactive constituents have been shown to modulate immune responses and possess potential anti-cancer activities, making it an area of interest for further research.
